question: Which 5 states had the most storm events from 1980 to 1995, considering only the top 1000 states with the highest event counts each year? Please use state abbreviations.
sql:
WITH all_counts AS (
  SELECT state, 1980 as yr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1980` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1981, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1981` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1982, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1982` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1983, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1983` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1984, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1984` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1985, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1985` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1986, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1986` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1987, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1987` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1988, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1988` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1989, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1989` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1990, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1990` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1991, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1991` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1992, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1992` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1993, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1993` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1994, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1994` GROUP BY state
  UNION ALL SELECT state, 1995, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1995` GROUP BY state
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT state, yr, cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM all_counts
),
top1000 AS (
  SELECT state, yr, cnt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 1000
)
SELECT state, SUM(cnt) as total_events
FROM top1000
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5
